title: One Typo, Wrong Continent
summary: CGP Grey explains why airport codes are inconsistent and sometimes confusing, from their origins in old weather station codes to the quirks that cause mistakes. He builds the story around a single typo that sent a flight to the wrong continent.
why: HN people point to it as a fun summary of how messy airport codes are, especially in threads on aviation falsehoods and code collisions.

quote.text: just fascinating and worth the watch
